prompts.name: approach
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW original scene for the next story beat of a small submarine game. Wide exact2:1 composition. The attached images are STYLE AND IDENTITY REFERENCES ONLY: image1 establishes the refined rounded work-sub hull with compact conning tower, three portholes and tail propeller; image2 establishes thick pump casing/impeller materials. Do not copy their scenes. One-bit old Macintosh adventure/woodcut illustration, real perspective and volume through overlapping solids, cropped foreground, receding scale and cast shadows. Large clean white highlights and solid black shadow masses, selective coarse25/50% ordered dither on curved shaded surfaces only. Restrained texture, not noisy all-over grain. Strong shapes that survive128x64 pixels. No people, silhouettes, hands, lettering, labels, captions, UI, border or watermark. No repair completion, no service lights or working mooring, no rewards. Scene: the freighter holds still UNDERWATER beside the inactive pump station at Pump Refuge in a deep dark cavern. Fully submerged scene: no surface waterline, horizon or mirror reflections. A thick cropped pipe and jagged rock in the very near lower-left foreground establish depth; midground right a large stationary cylindrical industrial pump with curved intake pipe and heavy flanged housing embedded in the cavern wall. Midground left the SAME recognizable refined work-sub from reference1, now EMPTY DECK with NO filter boxes, faces the pump in three-quarter view. Its two broad floodlights reveal the pipe elbow, rim and intake against black deep water. Distant silent structure recedes into black behind the pump, inactive lamps, no welcoming dock. Keep sub silhouette crisp and pump intake large. Quiet investigative hold rather than action or restoration.

prompts.name: cracked-impeller
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW original scene for the next story beat of a small submarine game. Wide exact2:1 composition. The attached images are STYLE AND IDENTITY REFERENCES ONLY: image1 establishes the refined rounded work-sub hull with compact conning tower, three portholes and tail propeller; image2 establishes thick pump casing/impeller materials. Do not copy their scenes. One-bit old Macintosh adventure/woodcut illustration, real perspective and volume through overlapping solids, cropped foreground, receding scale and cast shadows. Large clean white highlights and solid black shadow masses, selective coarse25/50% ordered dither on curved shaded surfaces only. Restrained texture, not noisy all-over grain. Strong shapes that survive128x64 pixels. No people, silhouettes, hands, lettering, labels, captions, UI, border or watermark. No repair completion, no service lights or working mooring, no rewards. Scene: close inspection of the open underwater pump at Pump Refuge. The large circular opening dominates the LEFT TWO THIRDS of frame in oblique three-quarter perspective, with a thick bright metal rim, black chamber depth, and three broad curved impeller vanes around a hub. One vane has an UNMISTAKABLE wide jagged black fracture crossing its full width, with a displaced chipped outer segment separated by a large dark gap. Make this gap about5 percent of image width so it remains obvious at128x64; this is the focal storytelling fact. The missing alignment must be visible, not a fine scratch. The long curved outer pump casing and one pipe recede to upper right into deep black water, a cropped pipe flange in lower foreground adds depth. Restrained off-camera submarine floodlight reveals the cracked vane and thick casing. No workshop, bench, wrench, freight lift or cargo, no active service facility, no people. Simplify details around the break, prioritize a readable broken part.

nativeRendering.method: Same balanced v3: source-cell RGB area mean; outside threshold +/-40 solid threshold result; inside use25/50/75% white split at threshold +/-13 with2x2 [[0,2],[3,1]].
nativeRendering.rendererRuntime: Node.js built-ins, run from repo root

const fs=require('fs'),z=require('zlib');function crc(b){let c=0xffffffff;for(const n of b){c^=n;for(let j=0;j<8;j++)c=(c>>>1)^((c&1)?0xedb88320:0);}return (c^0xffffffff)>>>0;}function chunk(t,b){let n=Buffer.alloc(4),tail=Buffer.alloc(4);n.writeUInt32BE(b.length);const body=Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(t),b]);tail.writeUInt32BE(crc(body));return Buffer.concat([n,body,tail]);}
for(const name of ['approach','cracked-impeller']){const base='docs/assets/pump-survey/'+name,png=fs.readFileSync(base+'.png');let w,h,ch,bufs=[];for(let p=8;p<png.length;){let n=png.readUInt32BE(p),t=png.toString('ascii',p+4,p+8),b=png.subarray(p+8,p+8+n);if(t==='IHDR'){w=b.readUInt32BE(0);h=b.readUInt32BE(4);ch=b[9]===2?3:b[9]===6?4:0;if(b[8]!==8||!ch)throw Error('Unsupported PNG');}if(t==='IDAT')bufs.push(b);p+=n+12;}const raw=z.inflateSync(Buffer.concat(bufs)),pix=Buffer.alloc(w*h*ch),stride=w*ch;let p=0;for(let y=0;y<h;y++){let f=raw[p++];for(let x=0;x<stride;x++){let a=x>=ch?pix[y*stride+x-ch]:0,b=y?pix[(y-1)*stride+x]:0,c=y&&x>=ch?pix[(y-1)*stride+x-ch]:0,v=raw[p++];if(f===1)v+=a;if(f===2)v+=b;if(f===3)v+=Math.floor((a+b)/2);if(f===4){let q=a+b-c,pa=Math.abs(q-a),pb=Math.abs(q-b),pc=Math.abs(q-c);v+=pa<=pb&&pa<=pc?a:pb<=pc?b:c;}pix[y*stride+x]=v&255;}}const out=Buffer.alloc(129*64);let white=0,previousDither=0,balancedDither=0;for(let y=0;y<64;y++){out[y*129]=0;for(let x=0;x<128;x++){let sum=0,count=0;for(let yy=Math.floor(y*h/64);yy<Math.floor((y+1)*h/64);yy++)for(let xx=Math.floor(x*w/128);xx<Math.floor((x+1)*w/128);xx++){let i=(yy*w+xx)*ch;sum+=(pix[i]+pix[i+1]+pix[i+2])/3;count++;}const lum=sum/count;const threshold=name==='approach'?96:127.5,lo=threshold-40,hi=threshold+40;if(lum>32&&lum<224)previousDither++;const middle=lum>lo&&lum<hi;if(middle)balancedDither++;const level=!middle?(lum>=threshold?4:0):lum<threshold-13?1:lum<threshold+13?2:3;const order=[[0,2],[3,1]];let v=level>order[y%2][x%2]?255:0;out[y*129+1+x]=v;white+=v===255;}}let hdr=Buffer.alloc(13);hdr.writeUInt32BE(128);hdr.writeUInt32BE(64,4);hdr[8]=8;hdr[9]=0;fs.writeFileSync(base+'-native.png',Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]),chunk('IHDR',hdr),chunk('IDAT',z.deflateSync(out)),chunk('IEND',Buffer.alloc(0))]));console.log(JSON.stringify({name,width:128,height:64,white,black:8192-white,previousDither,balancedDither,reductionPercent:+(100*(1-balancedDither/previousDither)).toFixed(1)}));}
